title: Shared event, version 1
description: One JSON object per line (JSON Lines). Written by Sonic (*.sonic.events.jsonl), VYRN (vyrn/<media>.events.jsonl) and the engine's timeline events; read by any of them through `aethern events`. A superset of docs/TIMELINE-FORMAT.md §10: same ids and type names, extra fields live in data. `v` is optional; a line without it is version 1.

id.description: <type>.<NN>, stable within one media/film, so the same event keeps its id across tools

type.description: dotted name, e.g. blade-contact, footstep, sonic.pick

conf.description: 1 = ground truth from the environment that made the media
